setup.title: Configure
setup.subtitle: Forza Horizon 2 runs on PC through Azimuth, by Almost There Games. Infinity needs Azimuth 0.9.10 with the Infinity hook.

setup.summary_missing: Let's get Azimuth set up. Follow the steps below.

setup.summary_ready: Azimuth is ready to play online.
setup.choose_title: Choose the folder that has azimuth.exe
setup.not_azimuth_folder: That folder doesn't have azimuth.exe. Choose the folder where you extracted Azimuth.
setup.step1: 1. Download Azimuth {version} (azimuth-windows.zip) from its official page on itch.io. Use only this page: copies elsewhere may be modified.
setup.step2: 2. Extract the zip into a new, empty folder (for example C:\Games\Azimuth). Don't extract it over an existing Azimuth folder: it would replace the Infinity hook.
setup.step3: 3. Run azimuth.exe once and select your Forza Horizon 2 game folder: the Xbox One version {game}, the folder with era.vbi, Mount and EmbeddedXvd. Storm Island and Fast & Furious are added on Azimuth's Game page.
setup.step4: 4. Come back here and press "Choose the Azimuth folder…" (or "Check again"). Infinity remembers it.
setup.disclaimer: Infinity doesn't include or download Forza Horizon 2 or Azimuth files: use your own copy of the game. Azimuth is an independent project by Almost There Games, not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox or Playground Games.

eo.locked: Kept off by Infinity: it conflicts with Infinity's online play.
eo.advanced_warning: Advanced: change these only if you know what they do.
eo.global.enabled.help: Turns every feature of the mod on or off.
eo.content.unlockdlc.help: Grants every DLC pack. Treasure Map and VIP have their own switches. Storm Island's map needs its package installed; its cars are available anyway.
eo.content.offlinevip.help: VIP perks: double credits and XP, and double wheelspin bonus.
eo.content.unlocktreasuremap.help: Reveals every bonus board and barn find, on the mainland and Storm Island. Turning it on, saving in game and turning it off keeps them found.
eo.content.unlockstormislandcars.help: Lets you buy the Ranger T6 and #7 SST without the Storm Island events.
eo.frontend.getincarfrompausemenu: Get in any car from the pause menu
eo.frontend.getincarfrompausemenu.help: Change cars anywhere in free roam: pick a car in My Cars in the pause menu.
eo.frontend.allrimscategory.help: Adds a category with every aftermarket and stock rim.
eo.frontend.enablemarketplace.help: Shows the pause menu's Marketplace tab.
eo.frontend.enablesocial.help: Shows the pause menu's Social tab.
eo.frontend.enableclubs.help: Shows the pause menu's Clubs tab.
eo.frontend.enablerivals.help: Shows the pause menu's Rivals tab.
eo.photomode.freecamera.help: Removes the photo mode camera's collisions and limits.
eo.autodrive.enabled.help: Set a GPS route in free roam, then press D-pad Down (or F2) and the car drives there. Steering, braking or pressing again gives control back.
eo.profile.customgamerpic.help: Uses Gamerpic.png from the game folder as your picture (up to 2048x2048, 16 MB; square PNG recommended).
eo.compatibility.disableparentallocks.he: Passes the game's local privilege checks for user-created content.
eo.compatibility.disableazimuthsavecheck: Skips Azimuth's save hash and size checks and rebuilds missing save markers at startup. Makes adding liveries to a save easier.
eo.files.enablemediaoverrides.help: Loads loose files next to the game (mediaoverride, then mediapc, then the original media). Restart the game after changing files.

bugs.title: Found a bug?
bugs.intro: Tell us what happened. Clear reports help us fix problems and keep everyone driving.
bugs.step1_body: Open our GitHub issue tracker and search for the problem. If someone has already reported it, add useful details to that issue.
bugs.step2_body: Sign in to GitHub, select New issue, and follow any available template. Include a short title, steps to reproduce, what you expected, and what actually happened.
bugs.step3_body: Add your launcher version, Windows or Proton version, and screenshots if they help. Remove personal information and credentials. Never attach passwords, tokens, account files, saves, or game files.

crash.title: Azimuth closed unexpectedly
crash.intro: You can send private metadata to help Infinity investigate, or copy a diagnostic report for support. Nothing is uploaded without your permission.
crash.roster_note: Snapshot from {time}; membership may have changed before the crash.
crash.roster_missing: World membership could not be confirmed locally. The service verifies available session history.
crash.blame_unknown: Cause not established. Being in the world or sending the last packet does not identify an offender.
crash.metadata_privacy: The service receives diagnostic codes, build versions and session/world IDs. It resolves participants from its own records. Names, local paths, tokens, chat, raw packets and memory are excluded. Reports support human review; they do not automatically freeze accounts.
crash.metadata_consent: I agree to send diagnostic metadata only to Infinity.
crash.dump_privacy: A local memory dump is available (up to 16 MiB). It may contain sensitive process memory. Saving it creates a file on your computer; the launcher will not upload it.
crash.no_dump: No matching dump is available. You can still send the diagnostic report.
crash.sent: Metadata received for human review. No memory was uploaded and no automatic penalty was applied.
crash.send_failed: Sending did not complete. The local report is kept. You can explicitly retry or copy it for support; an accepted metadata report will not be duplicated.
crash.local_failed: The local copy could not be removed.
crash.frozen: Online access is temporarily frozen for security review. Sign-in and support remain available.
crash.dumps_disabled: Infinity does not receive memory dumps in this phase. Only a separately consented metadata report can be sent.
crash.legacy_action: This pending action uses an earlier report format. Its consent and request will not be reused. Select the metadata consent and Send metadata only to create a separate action; no attachment will be sent.
crash.exported: Diagnostic copied or saved locally. Nothing was uploaded.
crash.export_failed: The diagnostic could not be copied or saved. The original local report is kept.
crash.private_support_help: Share the copied diagnostic with support. Send a memory dump only when requested, in the private support space identified by moderators. Never post a dump in a public channel.
crash.private_support_unset: No support destination is configured. Keep the diagnostic locally until a moderator identifies the private support space; never post a dump publicly.
crash.manual_dump_consent: I understand that the dump may contain sensitive information and choose to save a copy for manual private support.
community.contribution: Community participation is essential to the stability of our online services and a respectful playing environment. Reporting technical issues and inappropriate conduct helps our team investigate and take responsible action. Sending a report is voluntary.

integrity.incompatible: Some selected critical files differ from the server's compatibility reference. Online worlds are unavailable. Verify the installation or contact support for help.
